title: Stability inequality B.1 for a deformation-minimal smooth hypersurface of A₀ with minimal unit normal (Simon Ch. 2, 5.4 and 5.11–5.12; parent step 4)
statement:
Stability inequality (Simon B.1). Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: U is open; M ⊆ U; dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P for every r ∈ ℕ; H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; ν is C^∞ on some open set O ⊇ M; for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1, ν(x)·v = 0 for all v ∈ tangentSpace M x, and trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0; and for every C^∞ map Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport Z ⊆ U there is t₀ > 0 with H^m(M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ H^m({x + tZ(x) : x ∈ M ∩ tsupport Z}) for every t with |t| < t₀. Conclusion: for every ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ that is locally Lipschitz on M (LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ) and vanishes on M outside some compact set C ⊆ M,
 ∫_M |A|²(x)ζ(x)² dH^m(x) ≤ ∫_M |∇^Mζ|²(x) dH^m(x),
where |A|²(x) := Σ_{j=1}^P |Dν(x)(P_xe_j)|², |∇^Mζ|²(x) := Σ_{j=1}^P (d^M_xζ(P_xe_j))², Dν(x) = fderiv ℝ ν x, d^M_xζ := fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x, P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], and both integrals are Bochner integrals over M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ ν x).toLinearMap) = 0) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ U → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → ∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∫ x in M, (∑ j : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))‖ ^ 2) * ζ x ^ 2 ∂μHE[m] ≤ ∫ x in M, ∑ j : Fin P, (fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2 ∂μHE[m]
